summary.text: Danica Roem is a Democratic member of the Senate of Virginia for District 30, serving since 2024. The Senate's member page lists committee assignments including Agriculture, Conservation and Natural Resources, General Laws and Technology, and Transportation.

paragraphs.text: Danica A. Roem was born in Manassas, Virginia, on September 30, 1984, according to the Senate's member page.
The page says she earned a B.A. in journalism and mass communication from St. Bonaventure University and lists her occupation as executive director of Emerge Virginia.
The page lists her as a member of the House from 2018 to 2024 and a member of the Senate since 2024.
